title: Parallel Work Item workflow reliability
outOfScope: Changing AI Cockpit's boundary so that a Work Item becomes an agent scheduler or owns global orchestration.
Changing provider releases, tags, branch protection, CI runners, or publishing any public release.
Collapsing multiple Work Items into one branch or PR.

sources.reason: Defines one Work Item, one dedicated branch, and one PR, with lifecycle closure requirements.
Its linked-worktree active-record guard currently rejects a second independently governed Work Item.
Owns quality routing and ai-finish behavior; dry-run and archive verification must remain safe and bounded.
Installed adopters must receive the same quality-routing semantics.
Owns finish/archive verification and is the correct boundary for safe evidence reuse.
Documents the canonical Work Item lifecycle and must remain aligned with parallel agent orchestration.

rawUserRequest: 完成全部工单包括PR和清理。明确授权给你，并写入Contract。如果没有问题，请开始。全部完成为止不要停止。

declaredIntent.summary: Allow agents to orchestrate independent Work Items in separate worktrees without weakening Work Item isolation or making AI Cockpit a scheduler.

riskAssessment.reason: A workflow change can accidentally weaken Work Item isolation, execute mutating commands during a dry run, or reuse stale verification evidence.

reasons: The change affects governance lifecycle behavior and installed-template parity.

executionDecision.reason: The user explicitly authorized corrective Work Items, dedicated PRs, lifecycle closure, cleanup, and final release while retaining fail-closed checks.

preReviewWarnings: Parallelism remains agent orchestration: this Work Item may enable independent worktrees but must not make a Work Item a scheduler or alter the one-Work-Item/one-PR boundary.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: A second valid Contract/Summary pair in a distinct linked worktree can start when its branch is a dedicated Work Item branch, while malformed or conflicting records still fail closed.
make -n quality and its template equivalent remain non-mutating previews and do not execute recursive quality work.

ARCHIVE=true ai-finish reuses only verification evidence that is demonstrably bound to the same Work Item state; stale, missing, changed, or mismatched evidence reruns strict verification and fails closed on failure.
Focused regression tests cover each reliability boundary, and template/documentation/generated truth artifacts accurately state that agents—not Work Items—schedule parallel work.
The Work Item completes its own dedicated PR, merge, archive, lifecycle closure, and branch cleanup before release preparation resumes.
guidelines: Keep one task, one Work Item, one branch, and one PR; parallelism is agent orchestration across isolated worktrees.
Preserve fail-closed validation for malformed state, stale evidence, and quality failures.
Keep root and installed-template Makefile behavior aligned; do not introduce repository-specific installation assumptions.

intent.problem: Parallel practice exposed three reliability defects: ai-start treats any active linked-worktree record as a global lock; dry-running quality can execute recursive work because of forced recipe execution; and archive finish repeats a full strict run even when identical bound verification evidence exists. These defects make safe agent-level parallelism and bounded lifecycle closure impractical.
constraints: AI Cockpit remains a local Work Item governance interface; agents and subagents decide orchestration and concurrency.
Each independent task must retain its own Work Item Contract, isolated branch/worktree, PR, archive, and closure receipt.
No dry-run may execute quality commands, and cached verification may only be reused with strong same-state binding and fail-closed fallback.
Keep the root and distributed template behavior aligned.
intent.rationale: Resolving these mechanics enables the intended one-task/one-WI/one-PR parallel design without turning the governance layer into a scheduler or weakening evidence integrity.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: The user explicitly authorized continuous corrective Work Items, PRs, merges, closure, cleanup, and final release, subject to mandatory fail-closed gates.

rollbackNote: Revert this Work Item diff and restore related tests and docs.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Two agent-owned tasks have valid, distinct Contracts and Summaries in separate linked worktrees.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Both can proceed independently while each retains its own branch, PR, archive, and closure identity.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Exercise ai-start linked-worktree classification in focused unit tests and run the full governance checks.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A malformed, conflicting, or unauthorized linked-worktree record is present.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The start operation fails closed with a diagnostic instead of silently allowing unsafe concurrency.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add focused negative tests for malformed and non-Work-Item branch records.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A developer runs make -n quality or archives an unchanged verified Work Item.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Dry-run executes no recursive quality commands; archive may reuse only state-bound evidence and otherwise reruns strict verification.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add Makefile and finish-script regression tests, then run required quality and lifecycle checks.
